Several parts look like they are from an engine bay (mounting plates, brackets, and rubber components).

claims.claim: For engine seatng and engines mouthing
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo shows mixed engine-mount/bracket type parts but does not clearly confirm the exact item list or that they are complete/compatible.

risks.risk: Wrong compatibility (engine mount/bracket set may not fit the buyer’s engine/model).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part numbers/labels and the full set laid out with measurements (bolt-hole spacing) plus the engine make/model it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/possibly incompatible engine mounting parts (worst case: buyer may not be able to use them).

risks.risk: Missing pieces or incomplete set (photo shows multiple parts but not whether all required components are included).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing everything included in the package, counted and matched to a checklist (mounts, bolts, brackets, isolators).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing key mounting hardware).

risks.risk: Damaged/rusted rubber isolators or cracked brackets (wear may affect vibration isolation and fit).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each rubber bushing/isolator and bracket edges, plus a photo showing no cracks/tears.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/possibly damaged mounts (worst case: needs replacement).

risks.risk: Seller may be offering mixed parts from different engines (photo looks like assorted mounts/brackets).
risks.proof: Photo showing the exact source vehicle/engine and that all parts belong to the same set (one engine bay origin).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/uncertain set (worst case: only some pieces usable).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of any part numbers/labels on each mount/bracket (and where they are located).
Send the engine make/model the parts came from (and vehicle year if known).
Provide measurements: bolt-hole spacing and overall dimensions for each mounting plate/bracket.
Show a complete laid-out inventory of what is included (all pieces + any bolts/hardware).
Close-up photos of the rubber isolators for cracks/tears and of bracket welds/edges for breaks.
response.reason: The photo shows engine-mount/bracket type parts, but the exact item set and compatibility cannot be confirmed from the image (no readable part numbers/engine source). Without that, a worst-case price would be too unreliable.
